image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white dwarf hamster sitting inside a bright green plastic exercise wheel or bowl. The hamster has dense white fur, small dark eyes, rounded ears, and visible pink paws resting on the rim. The lighting is direct (likely flash), creating strong highlights on the fur and deep shadows in the background. A blue object is partially visible in the bottom right corner.

Two distinct, small, black bead-like eyes are clearly visible and symmetrically placed.
The ears are visible, rounded, and proportionate to the head size typical for a dwarf hamster.
